svg.title: Map of Hawaiʻi Island with nine numbered stops: a lava tube near Kona, Waikoloa, Mauna Lani, the Mauna Kea Beach Hotel, and Lapakahi along the west and north Kohala coast, the Waipiʻo Valley Lookout in the north, ʻAkaka Falls and Hilo on the east side, and Kīlauea's summit in the southeast.

g.aria-label: Go to stop 4, Mauna Kea Beach
